title: The Client
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: The Mandalorian Din Djarin received a mysterious, almost detail-less puck in a call for a particularly efficient bounty hunter. Mando accepted and became acquainted with The Client, a shadowy Imperial agent who offered payment in pure Beskar. When Djarin captured the valuable bounty, a mysterious child, he turned on the Client and  the Empire, wiping them all out.
